verdict.rationale: Provisioning a full developer toolchain with one command is a fair axis for an operating system, but the evidence pack never describes a package manager, configuration file, or one-command dev-environment setup. The docs cover WinUI and Windows App SDK app building, MSIX packaging, and supported languages, and the probe only notes that the PowerShell CLI exists, none of which shows single-command provisioning of packages, tools, and runtimes.
